public_rationale: The premise held. In June 2025 Musk said Grok was 'parroting legacy media' and that he was 'working on it'. Then he announced a plan to have Grok rewrite 'the entire corpus of human knowledge' and retrain on it. The forecast is that he will carry this out. xAI did launch Grokipedia, an AI-written encyclopedia. But I found no xAI statement or credible report showing that any Grok model was trained on a rewritten corpus. As of November 2025, commentators treated that as hypothetical. With no deadline and no decisive event, the forecast stays open.
limitations: Training-data details for Grok models are largely undisclosed.
Searches may have missed late-2026 reporting.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: After failing to make Grok match his personal beliefs, Musk will rewrite Grok's training data (history) so that it matches his views.
conditions: having failed to align Grok to his beliefs

statement.excerpt: He couldn't get Grok to align with his own personal beliefs so he is going to rewrite history to make it conform to his views.

from_speaker: He couldn't get Grok to align with his own personal beliefs
he is going to rewrite history
to make it conform to his views
He is going to rewrite the data
our_interpretation: Plain reading: Musk/xAI will rewrite a large training corpus to fit Musk's views and retrain Grok on it, as Musk announced on June 21, 2025.
Grokipedia, a public AI-written encyclopedia, does not count by itself unless it is shown to be used as Grok training data.
No deadline is stated, so the horizon is open.
criteria.support_condition: An xAI statement or credible reporting shows that a Grok model was trained on a corpus that Grok or xAI rewrote to change its content in line with Musk's views.
criteria.contradiction_condition: xAI states it dropped the plan, or credible documentation shows that later Grok models were trained without any rewritten corpus.
